text:
carol_release: kicking off canary for release v3.4.1 to prod-us-east. change window 20m. starting at 5% traffic -> ramp to 10% over 10m. backout runbook RB-73 is the source of truth: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/RELEASE/pages/RB-73-backout-runbook. @kevin_oncall as agreed you own the pager for this window.

deploy-bot: Deploy job started: job=deploy-1792004321, target=api-service:v3.4.1, canary=5% (10 nodes). logs: https://deploy.redwood.internal/jobs/deploy-1792004321

kevin_oncall: ack. I'll watch SLOs, error budget, and request latency dashboards. will call if anything hits thresholds.

maria_dev: quick excerpt from RB-73 for visibility — backout checklist (condensed):
1) stop canary ramp (set canary weight 0)
2) pin traffic to previous stable (api-service:v3.4.0)
3) disable feature flags introduced in v3.4.1
4) roll back schema changes if deploy included DB migrations (see migration rollback section)
5) open incident and runpostmortem template

maria_dev: snippet of commands we usually run (replace <env> and <job>):
```
# stop canary
curl -X POST \"https://control-plane.prod/api/v1/traffic\" -d '{"service":"api-service","weight":0,"tag":"canary"}'
# pin to previous
rwdctl route pin --service api-service --version v3.4.0 --env prod-us-east
# flip feature flag
ffctl set my_new_feature false --env prod
```

dave_infra: if the issue is model-related (inference regressions) use this to pin model variant back to quant-v1: 
```
rwdctl models set --service api-service --model_id redwood/text-infer --variant quant-v1 --env prod-us-east
```

ops-bot: Metric alert: api-5xx-rate > 2% for 3m on prod-us-east-us-east-1 (current 3.4%). Matches canary window.

kevin_oncall: seeing error spike on 4/5 canary nodes, latency p95 up ~120ms, error rate crossed threshold. preparing to execute backout plan now. paging ops and infra.

carol_release: decision: abort ramp and execute RB-73 backout. Steps we will run now: 1) run maria's stop canary command 2) pin traffic to v3.4.0 3) disable feature flag 4) monitor for 15 min 5) if stable, close change window. I'm opening the incident now.

deploy-bot: Backout initiated: job=backout-1792004321, actions=[stop-canary, pin-version, disable-ff]. link: https://deploy.redwood.internal/jobs/backout-1792004321

dave_infra: executed route pin -> api-service now pinned to v3.4.0 across prod-us-east, kube rollout status shows previous replicas healthy.

maria_dev: feature flag flipped off (my_new_feature=false). confirming no new failures in logs.

kevin_oncall: monitoring post-backout metrics: error rate dropping from 3.4% -> 0.9% over last 4m, p95 returning to baseline. will keep watch for full 15m.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3314, severity=high -> assigned to @kevin_oncall and @dave_infra. runbook link included.

carol_release: good work team. we'll pause the v3.4.1 rollout and schedule a gated retest after the postmortem. action items: engineering to triage root cause, infra to document any rollout gating changes, product to notify stakeholders.

kevin_oncall: I'll close the incident after 30m stable and post the brief timeline here. thanks all. :thumbsup:

dave_infra: rolling log snippet for handoff to SRE/pm:
```
[2026-03-20T14:02:13Z] deploy-1792004321 started
[2026-03-20T14:08:41Z] ops-bot alert api-5xx-rate > threshold
[2026-03-20T14:09:10Z] backout-1792004321 initiated
[2026-03-20T14:12:02Z] traffic pinned to v3.4.0
[2026-03-20T14:21:15Z] metrics stabilized
```

kevin_oncall: closing thread in ~30m if no regressions. posterity note: RB-73 worked as intended. we'll expand the checks in preflight next time.

carol_release: noted — will add extra synthetic tests to preflight checklist. closing for now. :white_check_mark:
